readme: Support targets — ONE curated list read by the member-data supporters duty (hourly) and by supporters.html + the site footer. Each entry is an address the site watches for transfers carrying its memo; gifts are kept write-once / never-shrink in member-data/supporters/<product>. Add a target = add a block here; nothing else changes. The builder's wallet stays on current.json for compatibility; an ally's treasury gets its own file.
